description: This Java interface defines an ExecutionContext for passing key/value pairs and managing tracing context, used within the Hono core utilities.

classes.name: ExecutionContext
classes.description: An interface providing methods to get/set arbitrary key/value data and manage tracing context in the application.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the specified key, returning null if the key isn't present.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the specified key, returning the default value if the key isn't present.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Associates the specified value with the specified key in the context.

methods.name: setTracingContext
methods.description: Sets the OpenTracing SpanContext for this execution context.

methods.name: getTracingContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current OpenTracing SpanContext associated with this execution context.
